title: Database Cleanup "corrupts" database, showing "red line in" overview.
symptom: After running Maintenance->Database Cleanup, AAPS shows a 'red line' in overview and in the History browser, as if the loop was disabled, even though it was not. The problem can be fixed through database reset + full NS sync.
evidence_quote: After database cleanup AAPS shows "red line" in overview and in the "History browser" (including in the past). As if loop was disabled (afaikt is was not)
